connector.name: WebCake Storefront
connector.registryDescription: Build pages and manage products, orders, and content on the WebCake/StoreCake storefront builder.
connector.summary: Hosted at store.toolvn.io.vn over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package webcake-storefront-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vuluu2k account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: x-webcake-jwt
headers.description: Storefront Bearer JWT (or authenticate via the OAuth flow / ?jwt= link).

env.name: WEBCAKE_TOKEN
env.description: Storefront JWT Bearer token (the builder's `jwt` cookie / store_jwt).

env.name: WEBCAKE_SESSION_ID
env.description: Session id sent as the x-session-id header (the builder's `wsid` cookie).

env.name: WEBCAKE_ENV
env.description: Named environment preset that fills the API + app base URLs (default prod).

env.name: PEXELS_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Pexels API key for the search_images tool.
